scope.goal: Track npm and pnpm conformance for browser guest runtime productization.

cases.notes: Guest runner classifies the command as version, and the async CLI module evaluator now runs the vendored npm entry through workspace CJS evaluation with dynamic import shims for the npm display path.

Guest runner classifies the command as version, and the async CLI module evaluator now runs the vendored pnpm entry through workspace CJS evaluation with Node-shape process/fs/os/stream/events/timers/zlib support.
Validates virtual store, workspace links, bin links, frozen lockfile invariants, and copy-fallback node_modules materialization from a native pnpm fixture.

cases.command: vendored CLI static require graph preflight and fixture CLI module evaluation
cases.notes: Walks vendored npm and pnpm entry module graphs, resolves simple computed path entries, expands npm install/ci/run/exec command dispatch, resolves npmPath package metadata probes, classifies Keyv adapter loading as optional for the default browser runtime store path, handles JSON modules, ignores string/comment false positives, rejects missing package modules, verifies there are no static unsupported builtin gaps, and counts only optional probes after product-scope graph expansion. Also evaluates npm-shaped CLI fixtures plus vendored npm/pnpm --version entries, vendored npm minipass-fetch HTTP response consumption, vendored npm local file dependency install/ci with .bin link materialization, vendored npm run/exec fixture commands through child_process shell shims, vendored pnpm exec fixture commands, and vendored pnpm local file dependency install from workspace modules through async cli-module-evaluation with BrowserProcess stdout/stderr/exit handling.

cases.productGap: Browser runtime can now run vendored npm CLI module evaluation for a local file dependency install and materialize package-lock plus symlinked node_modules and .bin links. Registry tarball dependency installs, run/exec, lifecycle, peer, and optional policy still need real CLI module evaluation coverage.

Browser runtime can now run vendored npm ci CLI module evaluation for a local file dependency from package-lock.json and re-materialize node_modules plus .bin links. Registry tarball ci, run/exec, lifecycle, peer, and optional policy still need real CLI module evaluation coverage.

Browser runtime can now run vendored npm run and npm exec fixture commands through real CLI module evaluation using browser child_process shims for sh -c, node -e, local .bin resolution, and stdio inherit forwarding. Full npm lifecycle process spawning, peer resolver execution, and optional package policy still need real CLI module evaluation.

Browser runtime can now run vendored pnpm CLI module evaluation for a local file dependency install and materialize symlinked node_modules package files, pnpm-lock.yaml, node_modules/.modules.yaml, and virtual-store lock.yaml, plus validate and materialize workspace-only frozen install layout with copy-fallback links. Registry dependency installs, run/exec, lifecycle, peer, and optional policy still need real CLI module evaluation coverage.

Browser runtime can now run vendored pnpm exec fixture commands through real CLI module evaluation using browser child_process shims and stream setEncoding support. Full pnpm run, lifecycle process spawning, peer resolver execution, and optional package policy still need real CLI module evaluation.

gate.reason: Version boot, vendored npm/pnpm --version async CLI module evaluation, vendored npm minipass-fetch HTTP response consumption, vendored npm local file dependency install and ci CLI module evaluation with .bin link materialization, vendored npm run/exec fixture CLI module evaluation, vendored pnpm exec fixture CLI module evaluation, vendored pnpm local file dependency install CLI module evaluation, local install layout, store plan, script-runner-application run/exec/lifecycle fixture, interrupted install-plan recovery, tarball cache paths, and product-scope static CLI graph classification pass or partially pass in browser guest runtime, but registry dependency install matrices and pnpm run plus npm/pnpm lifecycle/peer/optional CLI module evaluation still depend on host-node-test-helper or script-runner application paths as reference comparators. Static graph classification now covers simple computed entries, JSON modules, npm install/ci/run/exec command dispatch, npm config metadata probes, pnpm Keyv adapter optional loading, child_process diagnostics and CLI evaluator sh -c/node -e/.bin execution shims, crypto hashing/random subset, dns, fs/promises/open/FileHandle/chmod/chown/fsync/lstat/utimes/rm/readlink/rename/symlink/copyFile/link/readdir, http/https request abort/status/trailers, http2 diagnostics, net/tls unsupported diagnostics, inline worker_threads support for CLI evaluator worker pools, process.pid/process.report/process.hrtime, legacy url.parse/format/resolve, stream setEncoding, EventEmitter remove/off override safety, and lightweight constants/querystring/readline/string_decoder/timers/v8/zlib handle builtins. Remaining blocker is moving real registry installs, pnpm run, and lifecycle/peer/optional CLI evaluation off the host-node-test-helper before product support.
